out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink in the kitchen was observed at 73F and did not achieve proper hot water temperature.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC contacted county to repair handwashing sink.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Observed hot water at 3 compartment sink at 74F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC contacted county to repair hot water at the 3 compartment sink.

violations.title: Limited Food Manager - Issued by Health Department
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment which has only non-TCS foods and/or minimally prepares or handles Ready-to-Eat (RTE) food unless it is under the immediate control of a limited certified food manager.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a limited certified food managers certificate or full Food Protection Manager Certification.
